NoHiddenValue: No protected comparison value was captured for this item.
HiddenPresence: Protected configuration exists at one endpoint only. Its contents and fingerprint are not displayed.
HiddenUnchanged: The privately compared value was unchanged. Its contents and fingerprint are not displayed.
HiddenChanged: The privately compared value changed. Its contents were never saved; they cannot be reconstructed from the fingerprint.
AdvancedPrivacy: Recorded metadata only, not a full system audit. Technical identifiers may identify your device. Profile paths are redacted; review before copying or sharing. Secret values, fingerprints, and comparison keys remain hidden.
MachineAdminOnly: Machine administrator access; user standard access
SourceBoth: Selected current-user and shared machine configuration. No other private profiles.
ScopeQuestion: What would you like to check?
NoReviews: No review-priority changes in this view
NoReference: No earlier snapshot; current state only
NoHelpMatches: No matching help topics. Try another search.
SimpleHelp: Summaries, comparisons, and text reports. Collection and permissions do not change.
AdvancedHelp: Adds inline technical details and JSON/CSV reports. Does not grant administrator access.
UserScopeHelp: Your app registrations, startup entries, defaults, audio, proxy, and PATH.
MachineScopeHelp: Shared system configuration, not other users' private profiles.
ConsentHelp: ChangeTracker never asks for administrator access. Every check uses your standard Windows permissions; anything they cannot read is shown as incomplete.
PrivacyIntro: Selected configuration stays on this PC. No Windows settings are changed, no launch commands are stored, and nothing is uploaded.
BaselineIntro: A later check reveals the differences. Earlier changes cannot be reconstructed from a first baseline.
SourcesIntro: Read-only checks. All supported checks, including network and PATH, are enabled by default. Saved choices are preserved. Changing a selection does not run a check.
NoReviewsHelp: No findings in the current review filter. This is not a safety verdict; coverage and other changes remain below.
ManualHelp: Checks run on demand or at the selected automatic interval while the app is running. No network scan or telemetry runs. Closing hides the window; Exit in the system tray stops the app.
StorageHelp: Selected configuration and observation times stay in a local SQLite database. Launch values use a protected comparison key. The database itself is not encrypted.
SharingHelp: Reports redact profile paths and omit hidden values. Names and organizational details may remain. Preview before sharing. A change is not a malware verdict or proof of cause.
PriceHelp: $0.99 planned one-time Store purchase, including both modes. This preview has no purchase flow.
ReportPrivacy: Hidden values and profile paths are removed. Names may still identify your organization. JSON/CSV keep stable English field names and raw evidence.
AutomaticHelp: Every 4 hours by default; saved choices are preserved. ChangeTracker captures snapshots only while it is running, using standard access; it never requests administrator approval automatically and never wakes your PC. Choose Off for manual checks only.
StartWithWindows: Start ChangeTracker when I sign in
MinimizeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
StartupHelp: Close or Minimize keeps ChangeTracker running in the system tray. Use its Exit command to quit. Sign-in startup is optional and starts hidden; it changes only this app's per-user startup entry. No Windows service is installed.
SnapshotStorageHelp: Local history files for all scopes, including database overhead and temporary SQLite files. Adjust Snapshot frequency and Data retention in Settings to manage growth. Baselines and named checkpoints are kept. Deleting snapshots can leave reusable space, so file size may not shrink immediately.
ScheduledCheckSaved: Automatic check saved at {0}. Windows settings were not changed.
ScopeSelected: {0} selected. No check started and no administrator access requested.
CheckSaved: {0} check saved at {1}. Windows settings were not changed.
CheckingStandard: Checking selected sources with standard access...
CheckCanceled: Check canceled. The previous history and baseline are unchanged.
ChooseSource: Choose at least one source before checking.
SaveFailed: The check could not be saved. Existing history was preserved. Check available disk space and source access.
ActionFailed: That action could not be completed. Check the selected snapshot or destination. No Windows settings were changed.
NoMatchingDate: No saved snapshot on the selected before date. Choose another date or Current state only.
ScopeMismatch: Choose snapshots with the same collection scope and administrator access.
MissingReference: The selected before snapshot is no longer available. Choose another snapshot.
ReferenceMismatch: Choose a before snapshot with matching scope and access, or Current state only. Administrator access is never requested automatically.
FutureReference: The before snapshot is dated in the future. Check the clock or choose an earlier snapshot.
ChooseBoth: Choose a saved snapshot for both dates. Days without snapshots cannot be compared.
EarlierFirst: The before snapshot must be earlier than the after snapshot.
Chronological: Choose two distinct snapshots in chronological order.
Compared: Custom comparison. The baseline has not changed.
CheckpointLength: Enter a checkpoint name between 1 and 120 characters.
CheckpointSaved: Checkpoint name saved locally. Names are not included in reports.
ChooseNewBaseline: Choose another baseline for this scope and access before deleting this snapshot.
HistoryCleared: Local history cleared. Collection preferences were kept.
CaptureForReport: Take a first snapshot before creating a report.
DetailsCopied: Sanitized details copied. Review names and paths before sharing.
ReplaceBaselineConfirm: Use this saved snapshot as your baseline? Its original capture time will be retained. No Windows settings will change.
DeleteConfirm: Delete this local snapshot? Exported reports will not be deleted.
ClearConfirm: Delete all local snapshots and expected-change marks? This cannot be undone. Windows settings and exported files will not change.
ClipboardBusy: The clipboard is busy. Please try again.
ReportSaved: Report saved. No data was sent anywhere.
ReportSaveFailed: The report could not be saved. Choose another location. Local history was not changed.
HistoryOpenFailed: Local history could not be opened. Existing data has not been deleted. Close other copies and check the data folder and version.
DisabledCount: ; {0} sources not selected or outside scope
Unchanged: No differences detected in compared areas: {0}
PrivateSummary: Privately compared configuration changed; sensitive values are not displayed.
Uncertainty: The cause and exact change time are not known.
ReasonProtection: A protection setting changed. Review its current state in Windows Security; intent and cause are not known.
ReasonLaunch: A background launch registration changed. Registration does not prove execution; launch arguments are not stored.
ReasonVersion: Only this registered app's version changed. Other review findings remain separate; this is not a safety verdict.
ReasonApp: Installed-app metadata changed. The installer, impact, or related comparison coverage may be unknown.
ReasonDefaults: Links or files may now open in a different application.
ReasonAudio: Applications using Windows audio defaults may use a different speaker or microphone.
ReasonNetwork: Network configuration changed and can affect connectivity. Dynamic changes may be expected.
ReasonDrivers: Driver metadata changed. Device behavior may differ; a driver date is not an installation time.
ReasonPath: Persisted PATH changed. Review additions, removals, ordering, and duplicates; no executables were run.
ReasonUpdate: Windows reported an update-history change. It does not prove the cause of a problem.
ReasonOther: A difference was observed; its impact has not been assessed.
GapHelp: No reliable comparison is available for this source. Check both observations' completeness, scope, format, and comparison key.
PartialHelp: Some entries could not be read. This source is compared only when both readings are complete.
FailedHelp: Windows did not provide a usable reading or the check timed out. No settings were changed.
SourceUser: Current-user configuration only; no machine settings or other profiles.
SourceMachine: Shared machine configuration only; no private user profiles.
SourcePrivate: Read-only metadata. Hidden launch values are privately compared, never executed or stored as commands.
SourceNetwork: Proxy in user scope; adapter DNS/DHCP in machine scope. No packets, passwords, or probes.
SourcePath: Persisted PATH only, preserving order and duplicates. No other environment values or directory scans.
Name: Name
ReportLimitations: Selected observations only. Changes between checks and unavailable areas may be missed. Correlation is not causation or proof of safety. Names can identify people or organizations; review before sharing. Hidden values and checkpoint names are omitted.
